name: Herbs C
overview: The Scriptures in Exodus 9:22-25 depict the powerful judgment of God upon Egypt through a devastating hailstorm that struck every herb and tree in the fields, demonstrating His sovereign control over creation. This passage highlights how even the smallest elements of the natural world, such as herbs, are subject to God's authority and purpose. The destruction of the herbs and crops illustrates the seriousness of God's judgment while affirming that all created things, including cultivated plants, exist under His command.
